name: jot
description: Shared, local-first memory for every AI agent, stored as Markdown and versioned in git.
long_description: jot gives every MCP client one memory on your machine. Agents call `recall` at the start of a task and `remember` when you state a preference, make a decision or correct them. Memories are plain Markdown files in `~/.jot`, and every change is a git commit.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Save a preference, decision, fact or note

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Search memory for what's relevant to the task

tools.name: list
tools.description: Newest memories, filtered by kind or tags
